messages.subject: Imagemaps?
parts:
Greetings, all.

I'm wondering if any of you have taken your ggplot output and done
clickable imagemaps with it?

I've been generating some monitoring and analysis graphs for years
with R,


http://open-systems.ufl.edu/tsm/graphs/ALL.html

in which all the series are clickable, permitting the user to 'zoom
in' on the portion of activity that interest them. I've gotten
ggplot2 to generate similar images,

http://open-systems.ufl.edu/tsm/tmp/foo.png


(in 1/50th the lines of code, natch!)

but I haven't seen any mention of imagemaps. Any pointers?


- Allen S. Rout
